intro: Numbers from our 2026 transparency report, ready to be quoted. The full report has the detail behind them.
copyText: Cloud Native Days Italy 2026: 285 attendees from 117 companies and 18 countries, 60% first-timers, 49 speakers, 228 CFP submissions, 15 sponsors, 29 communities and open source projects, 18 organizers. Sessions satisfaction score 4.70 out of 5. Savoia Hotel Regency, Bologna. Full transparency report: cloudnativedaysitaly.org
